description: A program/v1 or agent/v1 competition's check reveal as it stands: its final scores, sealed at the deadline, shown part by part over its running phase (reveal: the bundle's block, its parts with each one's max, the held ones and duration_sec), the winner last. status: none (no check reveal: get_live has its board), scheduled (sealed until the reveal starts, once the final grades and checks pass: nothing of it is shown before), running, ended, fallback (its checks failed: no step, every result published at once at its end, the reason naming no entry), unavailable or published (the results came out with no reveal). sentence: one sentence with the time (UTC) of what comes next. From its start: timetable (stage 1 shows each open part for every entry at once, a step every stage1_step_ms; stage 2 resolves the held parts bottom-up, the lowest entry not yet placed showing its next one; steps, ends_at: the last step's time, when the results publish), latest_step, and board: every entry's position, total, ceiling (the most it can still reach), the parts shown with their points (one per trial on agent/v1, whose totals are each entry's integer-sum mean over its trials to six places), the parts pending and, once placed, its final place; decided, the entry whose total beats every other ceiling; next, the step after. step: the board after an earlier step already published (a later one is an error). aside: the entries it lists but does not rank, their values out with the results. House and internal entries are left out here, so the timetable counts the entries this surface lists. `stream` names its stream (Server-Sent Events, each step at its time, HTTP only): call this tool again for the next step.

slug.description: The competition slug, e.g. chess-engine-01 (list_competitions lists them)

step.description: The board after this step, one already published (0: the opening board); default the latest

name: get_reveal
title: Get a competition's check reveal
